title: Blank world map
subject: Geography
source: Written for geography/y5 lesson 5 (Blank world map (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 5. Label the seven continents and five oceans.

blocks.caption: Outline from Natural Earth (public domain); modern coastlines and borders.

questions.q: Is Sicily an island? How do you know?
questions.a: Yes: it has sea all around it
questions.model: Look at Sicily on the map. Trace the coast all the way round. Water on every side, so it is an island.

questions.q: Core: On a world map, mark and label Greenland, Great Britain, Madagascar, Sicily, Sri Lanka and the Maldives.
questions.a: Greenland north-east of Canada; Great Britain north-west Europe; Madagascar off south-east Africa; Sicily south of Italy; Sri Lanka south of India; Maldives south-west of India
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: find India, look south, the tear-shaped island is Sri Lanka; label it.

questions.q: Extend: Label the ocean or sea around each island.
questions.a: Greenland: Arctic and Atlantic; Great Britain: Atlantic and North Sea; Madagascar and Maldives and Sri Lanka: Indian; Sicily: Mediterranean

questions.q: Stretch: Give one advantage and one challenge of living on an island.
questions.a: For example: fishing and trade by sea; harder to travel and get goods

questions.q: Big question: is Great Britain an island, and does it matter?
questions.a: Yes; it matters because the sea affected its trade, defence, weather and history
